name: NickRawcliffe
noteEs: NickRawcliffe es la voz inglesa para Valheim hardcore — speedruns con regla 'no resets' (si morís, pierdes runs), boss progression aggressive, y muchos lives. Su serie 'Valheim No Resets Speedrun' es referencia para runners que quieren ver execution en tiempo real, no editorial. Cubre también DayZ y otros survivals — Valheim ocupa la mayoría de uploads pero comparte canal.
noteEn: NickRawcliffe is the English voice for hardcore Valheim — speedruns with a 'no resets' rule (die and you lose runs), aggressive boss progression, and lots of live streams. His 'Valheim No Resets Speedrun' series is a reference for runners wanting to see execution live, not edited. He also covers DayZ and other survival games — Valheim takes most uploads but shares the channel.
highlightsEs: Speedruns 'No Resets' — la regla más exigente del Valheim challenge community
Live streams largos donde se ve execution real, sin cortes editoriales
Boss kills documentados con context (gear, food, sequence)
Pivote a DayZ ocasional, pero Valheim es el core
highlightsEn: 'No Resets' speedruns — the strictest rule in the Valheim challenge community
Long live streams showing real execution, no editorial cuts
Boss kills documented with context (gear, food, sequence)
Occasional DayZ pivots, but Valheim is the core
